nodes.text:
Third of us. Grip, Coin, me. Same trade, same lack of questions, worse weather.

What have you got that's no use to anyone?

choices.label: Three of you, all the way out here?

nodes.text:
There'll always be three of us. Wherever people carry things they can't explain, someone turns up who won't ask.

The old man's boat is how it moves. When he stops running it, we'll be three strangers with three boxes and nothing between us.
